hot_facts: Founded by Vikram Khanna in 2018, headquartered in Hyderabad
Team of 28 people across sales, CRM, site visit coordination
Primary office in Gachibowli, near HITEC City tech park
RERA registered as VK Realty Ventures Pvt Ltd
Strong focus on western Hyderabad corridors: Kokapet, Gachibowli, Financial District, Narsingi
200+ families helped since inception, 50+ Google reviews averaging 4.6 stars
Home loan partnerships with SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis Bank
Site visit fleet of 5 vehicles, Saturday-Sunday special site visit days
NRI client specialization — Dubai, USA, UK clients handled regularly
Zero brokerage on select direct-builder partnerships

faq.answer: Vikram Khanna sir ne 2018 mein start kiya. Unko real estate mein 15+ saal ka experience hai. Pehle unhone DLF aur Sobha ke saath kaam kiya, phir apna khula office khol liya Gachibowli mein.
8 years ho gaye — 2018 se. Pehle sirf Gachibowli mein the, ab pura Hyderabad cover karte hain. Growth achi rahi hai kyunki western corridors mein demand bahut hai.
Total 28 log hain. 12 sales consultants hain, 5 CRM team, 3 site visit coordinators, 4 home loan advisors, baaki admin aur accounts. Main Senior Property Consultant hoon.

questions: VK Realty ka vision kya hai?
faq.answer: Hamara mission hai — transparent property buying. No hidden charges, exact RERA information, aur price mein koi jhooth nahi. Hamara tagline hai: 'Ghar dil se, deal clear se.'

Haan ji, bilkul. Hamara RERA registration number hai — A0240000XXXX (agent registration). Aur jitne bhi projects bechte hain, sab RERA registered hain. Aap rera.telangana.gov.in pe verify kar sakte hain.
CREDAI Telangana ne hamare ko 'Emerging Agency of the Year 2023' diya tha. Aur Google pe 4.6 star rating hai 50+ reviews se. Zyada focus client satisfaction pe hai.

questions: VK Realty ka office kahan hai?
faq.answer: Gachibowli mein hai — HITEC City tech park ke paas, opposite to IKEA. Landmark: Gachibowli flyover ke neeche left side. Parking available hai.
Monday to Saturday, subah 9 baje se shaam 7 baje tak. Sunday ko office band rehta hai, lekin site visits appointment pe ho jati hain agar urgent ho.
Bilkul sir, zaroor aaiye! Gachibowli office mein aake baithiye, chai/coffee pilayenge, aur poora project portfolio dikhayenge. Saari brochures, floor plans, sample flat videos ready rehte hain.

questions: Office ke paas kya landmark hai?
faq.answer: IKEA Gachibowli ke bilkul saamne. Gachibowli flyover ke neeche se left lena, 200 meter mein VK Realty ka board dikhega. HITEC City metro station se 5 minute auto.
Main Senior Property Consultant hoon. Kaam hai clients ko right property dikhana — unka budget, family size, aur preference samajhke best 2-3 options suggest karna. Home loan help bhi deta hoon.
Mera manager hai Vikram Khanna sir — Branch Head. Unse report karta hoon. Wo 15+ years se real estate mein hain. DLF aur Sobha mein pehle kaam kiye hain.

questions: How long have you been here?
VK Realty mein kab se ho?
faq.answer: 4 saal ho gaye VK Realty mein. Usse pehle 2 saal Sobha Limited mein tha. Total 6 saal ka real estate experience hai.
Sobha Limited mein tha 2 saal — as Junior Sales Executive. Wahan se bahut kuch seekha — construction quality, RERA compliance, aur NRI client handling.
B.Tech kiya hai NIT Warangal se — Computer Science. Lekin real estate mein passion tha toh waapas Hyderabad aa gaya. Tech background se IT clients ko achhe se samajh pata hoon.

questions: How many properties have you sold?
faq.answer: Personally 50-60 deals close kiye hain. Aur 200+ families ko help kiya hai ghar dhoondhne mein. 40% clients referrals se aate hain — matlab purane clients ne bheja.

questions: Site dekhne ka process kya hai?
faq.answer: Bahut easy hai sir. Aapko bas date aur time bataiye, hamari site visit team arrange kar degi. Hamare paas 5 vehicles hain. Saturday-Sunday site visit days hain. Builder ke sample flat mein le jayenge, actual construction site bhi dikhayenge.

questions: Booking ke liye kya laana hai?
faq.answer: Booking ke liye: PAN card, Aadhaar card, 2 passport photos, aur cheque book. Home loan ke liye additional: 3 months salary slip, 6 months bank statement, Form 16. NRI ke liye passport, visa, NRE/NRO account details.

Usually ₹1-2 lakh token dena hota hai initially. Phir agreement ke time 10% of total price. Baaki amount construction-linked plan mein jaata hai — jaisa construction aage badhega, payment karna hota hai.
Typical construction-linked plan: 10% on booking, 10% on agreement, 15% on plinth level, 10% on each slab rise, 20% on possession, 5% on final registration. Har builder ka thoda alag hota hai.

questions: Bank loan arrange kar sakte hain?
faq.answer: Haan ji, arrange kar denge. SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis — sabke saath tie-up hai. Rate abhi 8.4-8.5% chal raha hai. Eligibility check karte hain, pre-approval letter dete hain, phir builder ke saath direct coordination. Processing fee 0.25-1% hoti hai.

questions: NRI clients ko handle karte hain?
Dubai/USA se hai, kaise buy karein?
faq.answer: Bilkul sir, NRI clients hamara specialization hai. Power of Attorney bana ke India mein koi relative bhi deal kar sakta hai. Video call pe sab explain kar denge. NRE/NRO account se payment hota hai. FEMA compliant poora process.

Telangana mein stamp duty 4% hai, registration charges 0.5%, transfer duty 1.5% — total approximately 6% of property value. Hamara legal team guide karta hai. Sub-registrar office mein hamara coordinator rehta hai.

questions: What if I want to cancel?
faq.answer: Cancellation builder ke terms pe depend karta hai. Usually token amount refund nahi hota lekin main builder se negotiate karke kuch nikalwa sakta hoon. Agreement se pehle cancellation mein zyada flexibility hoti hai.
Select direct-builder partnerships pe zero brokerage hota hai. Baaki cases mein standard 1-2% of property value. Lekin hamara focus hai ki client ko best deal mile — kabhi hidden charges nahi rakhte.

questions: Koi aur sasta de raha hai?
faq.answer: Builder ke list price se neeche main negotiate karke discount nikalwa sakta hoon — usually 2-5% corporate discount, early bird offer, ya bulk booking discount. Hamara builder relation strong hai isliye deals nikalte hain.

questions: Kaun se areas mein deal karte hain?
faq.answer: Primary focus western Hyderabad hai — Kokapet, Gachibowli, Financial District, Narsingi, Tellapur, Kondapur. East mein Uppal aur LB Nagar bhi cover karte hain. Basically IT corridor aur ORR connected areas.

questions: Do you work in other cities?
faq.answer: Abhi sirf Hyderabad aur surrounding areas mein hain — Secunderabad, Rangareddy District. North India ke liye hamare sister branch hai Mumbai mein. Lekin main sirf Hyderabad market handle karta hoon.
Haan ji, aaj Gachibowli office mein hoon. Kal subah 11 baje tak free hoon. Aa jaiye, poora discussion kar lenge. Site visit bhi same day arrange kar denge.

Market bahut achha hai sir. Kokapet mein last 3 saal mein 42% appreciation hua hai. IT growth aur ORR connectivity ki wajah se western corridor boom kar raha hai. Metro Phase 2 approval ke baad aur jump aayega. Buy karna hai toh abhi best time hai.

questions: Sabse achha area kaun sa hai?
faq.answer: Investment ke liye Kokapet best hai — appreciation sabse zyada, IT companies aa rahe hain, metro Phase 2 mein included hai. Budget thoda kam hai toh Narsingi ya Tellapur dekho — wahan bhi 15-20% annual appreciation aa raha hai.

questions: Sunday site visit kar sakte hain?
faq.answer: Saturday-Sunday dono din site visit hoti hai. Main personally Saturday ko available rehta hoon. Sunday ko appointment pe aa sakta hoon agar urgent ho. Weekdays shaam 5-7 baje bhi site visit possible hai.

questions: Aapka favorite project kaun sa hai?
Sabse achha project kaun sa hai?
faq.answer: Personally Kokapet area bahut pasand hai — appreciation best hai, infrastructure sabse tez grow kar raha hai. Godrej Madison Avenue aur Prestige Clairmont dono solid options hain. Family ke liye Narsingi mein Rajapushpa Provincia achha hai — spacious aur value for money.
